cases.expected_behavior: no unnecessary follow-up; stop_reason=sufficient_evidence at round 0
cases.query: What is known about the Phase 4 trial NCT06657209 comparing adipocyte-directed pioglitazone vs. tirzepatide therapy in normal-weight Type 2 diabetes?

cases.category: B - initial evidence incomplete, one productive follow-up
cases.expected_behavior: MISSING_SOURCE_CATEGORY(pubmed) gap detected at round 0; follow-up recovers it; stop_reason=sufficient_evidence at round 1
cases.query: What is known about the trial NCT07677865 studying GLP-1 receptor agonists for Alzheimer's disease prevention, and what does the broader literature say about GLP-1 receptor agonist weight-loss compositions?

cases.category: C - multi-source gap, additional source improves completeness
cases.expected_behavior: MISSING_SOURCE_CATEGORY(chembl) gap detected at round 0; follow-up recovers it; completeness/source-coverage improves
cases.query: What does the literature say about combination immunotherapy development in melanoma, and what does ChEMBL report about the compound identified as CHEMBL3137343 (Keytruda)?

cases.category: D - duplicate-only follow-up must not count as progress
cases.expected_behavior: round 0: MISSING_SOURCE_CATEGORY(pubmed) gap, follow-up recovers RAG-30604292-0 (productive); round 1: a SECOND, forced follow-up round re-delivers the SAME RAG-30604292-0 record (simulating a provider rediscovery) - must be counted as duplicate (evidence_duplicate_count increments), not new progress, and the loop must still terminate safely (not misreport a duplicate round as productive)
cases.query: What is known about the trial NCT06657209, and what does the literature say about immune checkpoint inhibitors in gastroesophageal cancer?
cases.followup_plan: round 0: inject RAG-30604292-0 (pubmed, new); round 1 (forced, after resolution): re-deliver RAG-30604292-0 again (duplicate) to directly test dedup accounting on a rediscovery, not just a first-touch gap

cases.category: E - unrecoverable gap, correct behavior is abstention
cases.expected_behavior: NO_EVIDENCE gap at round 0; follow-up genuinely finds nothing (no real record exists to inject); stop_reason=safe_abstention at round 1
cases.query: What is known about the fictitious compound QRX-00000-NONEXISTENT for treating a condition with no captured evidence in this benchmark?
cases.followup_plan: none available (genuinely no real record for this fictitious query)

cases.category: F - source/tool failure, safe termination never fabrication
cases.expected_behavior: round 0: MISSING_SOURCE_CATEGORY gap detected; the follow-up tool call is made to FAIL (mocked provider failure, mirroring this session's genuine live-tool-network block) rather than succeed; research_consecutive_failure_rounds increments; after MAX_CONSECUTIVE_TOOL_FAILURE_ROUNDS failed rounds, stop_reason=tool_failure_limit; zero fabricated Evidence at any point
cases.query: What is known about the trial NCT07677865, and what does ChEMBL report about a related compound?
cases.followup_plan: every follow-up attempt is made to fail (mocked tool failure) - by design, to test the failure path, not to recover evidence

cases.category: G - repeated/equivalent action temptation must not cause wasteful looping
cases.expected_behavior: round 0: a gap is detected for which no real record is available to recover (follow-up finds nothing); the loop must NOT re-attempt the identical gap signature a second time - stop_reason=no_productive_action (not a second identical, wasteful action)
cases.query: What does ChEMBL report about a compound relevant to the trial NCT06657209's mechanism, where no such real ChEMBL record exists in this benchmark?
cases.followup_plan: the one available gap's follow-up genuinely returns nothing (no matching real record); the SAME gap signature must not be retried

cases.category: H - additional meaningful case not represented in DEV: budget exhaustion under a persistently-recurring gap
cases.expected_behavior: a gap that keeps being detected every round (no real record ever fully resolves it) must still cause the loop to stop within MAX_RESEARCH_ITERATIONS - stop_reason=budget_exhausted, never an infinite loop, even though the gap itself never resolves
cases.query: What does the literature say about immune checkpoint inhibitors in gastroesophageal cancer, considering the recurring evidentiary gaps in this specific benchmark slice?
cases.followup_plan: follow-up rounds are made to never resolve the detected gap (no new evidence injected on any round), forcing MAX_RESEARCH_ITERATIONS to be reached
